newsitem.title: ITALY: S.Paolo 1st half operating profit up.
newsitem.headline: S.Paolo 1st half operating profit up.

text.p: Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said its first half operating profit was 30 percent higher than in the year earlier period.

The bank also said in a statement operating profit would have been six percent higher on a comparable basis, taking into account a merger with Crediop and Banca Nazionale delle Comunicazioni. Crediop was subsequently demerged.
San Paolo said operating profit per share in the first half was up by more than 20 percent at more than 1,200 lire from about 1,000 lire.
